book.name: Luka
book.title: Mbuli Inogile ya Yesu Kilisito yandikigwe na Luka

content: Lusimo lwa mgane na msemi
Abaho Yesu kawafundiza wanahina zake kwa lusimo kamba siku zose olondigwa kumpula Imulungu na sikuwadonhe.
Kalonga, “Kudibuga dimoja kukala na msemi yakalile hamdumba Imulungu hebu kuwatonga wanhu.
Vivija kudibuga dijo, kukala na mgane imoja yakalile komgendela msemi ayo baho kwa baho, kampula, ‘Ngwelele haki yangu kulawa kwa munhu yanitendele gehile.’
Siku nyingi msemi ayo hamtegeleze mgane ayo, lakini kumwande kailongela, ‘Hata kamba simdumba Imulungu hebu kuwatonga wanhu,
lakini kwavija mgane ino konigaza, nomgwaa haki yake, kwavija nahaleka, kogendelela kwiza hano na kunigaza!’ ”
Abaho Mndewa kagendelela kulonga, “Tegelezeni kiyalongile msemi ija yehile.
Vino, Imulungu honda yawagwee haki wanhu zake yawasagule, omulilila imisi na ikilo? Vino kokawa kuwategeleza?
Nowalongela, kowagwaa haki yao himahima. Lakini Mwana wa Munhu vonda yeze, vino kodivika tamanilo mwiisi?”
Lusimo lwa Mfalisayo na mbokela kodi
Abaho Yesu kawalongela lusimo luno wanhu waja wakalile oitapa wanoga na kuwabeza wayagwe.
“Kukala na wanhu wabili wacholile kumpula Imulungu kuna Ing'anda ya Imulungu. Imoja kakala Mfalisayo na iyagwe kakala mbokela kodi.
“Mfalisayo ayo kainega kumgwazo na kumpula Imulungu, ‘Go Imulungu, nokugwaa nhogolwa kwavija niye sili kamba wanhu wayagwe, wabokaji, otenda gehile, hebu wagoni. Wala sili kamba ino mbokela kodi.
Niye nofunga kuja miyanza mibili mzisiku saba, na nolava fungu da longo da vinhu vangu vose vinipata!’
“Lakini ija mbokela kodi kema kutali, hadahile hata kwinula meso gake kuulanga, lakini kaitowa mhambaga yake kwa usungu, kalonga, ‘Go Imulungu, nyonele bazi, niye na mwene nzambi!’

Nowalongela, mbokela kodi ija kachola ukae kumwake kuno katendigwa kanoga mgameso ga Imulungu kubanza ija Mfalisayo. Kwavija wose oitenda wanhu wakulu ohumulusigwa, na waja oihumulusa otendigwa wanhu wakulu.”
Yesu kowatambikila wana wadodo
Wanhu wayagwe wamgalila Yesu wana wadodo yawekile makono. Wanahina viwone avo, wawakomhokela.
Lakini Yesu kawakema iwana, kalonga, “Walekeni wana wadodo weze kumwangu, sikumuwagomese, kwavija Undewa wa Imulungu wa wanhu kamba wano.
Nowalongeleni ukweli! Munhu yoyose yolema kuubokela Undewa wa Imulungu kamba mwana mdodo, honda yengile ng'o!”
Munhu tajili
Mkulu imoja kamuuza Yesu, “Mfundiza Unogile, nhende choni niupate ugima wa milele?”
Yesu kamuuza, “Habali kong'hema, ‘unogile’? Kuduhu yanogile, ila Imulungu yaiyeka.
Kugajuwa Malagizo, ‘Sikuutende ugoni, sikuukome, sikuwibe, sikuulonge uvizi, wategeleze tatako na mamako.’ ”
Munhu ija kedika, “Gago gose nigagoga toka haudodo.”
Yesu viyahulike avo, kamulongela, “Kuhungukiligwa na kinhu kimoja. Chuuza vose viulinavo, uwagwee sente wanhu wakiwa, na gweye kokuwa na ngama yako kuulanga. Abaho wize unikweleleze.”
Lakini munhu ayo viyahulike avo, kanyunyuwala kwavija kakala tajili ng'hani.
Yesu viyamone kanyunyuwala, kalonga, “Vino avo vonda iwe vidala kwa wanhu matajili kwingila Muundewa wa Imulungu!
Kwavija vibuha kwa ngamiya kubita mna ikizonzo cha sanzia, kubanza tajili kwingila muundewa wa Imulungu.”
Wanhu wamuhulike, wamuuza, “Avo lelo nani yonda yadahe kukomboligwa?”
Yesu kawedika, “Vinhu havidahika kwa wanhu, kwa Imulungu vodahika.”
Abaho Petulo kalonga, “Lola! Siye tuvileka vinhu vetu vose, tukukweleleza gweye.”
Yesu kawalongela, “Nowalongela kweli, munhu yoyose yoleka kae yake hebu mwehe wake hebu ndugu zake hebu tatake na mamake hebu wanage mbuli ya Undewa wa Imulungu,
kobokela vinhu vingi ng'hani mna ikipindi kino na kobokela ugima wa milele mna ikipindi chonda kize.”
Yesu kolonga lwa kadatu mbuli ya ifa yake
Yesu kawagala hamgwazo wanahina zake longo na wabili, kawalongela, “Tegelezeni! Tochola Yelusalemu. Kuko kila kinhu chandikigwe na watula ndagu wa Imulungu mbuli ya Mwana wa Munhu cholawilila.
Kwavija kogeligwa mmakono ga wanhu haweli Wayahudi, nao omzeha, omuliga, na omtemela mate.
Omtowa mbalati na kumkoma, lakini siku da kadatu kozilibuka.”
Lakini wanahina hawazijuwile bule mbuli azo, kwavija wakala wafisigwe na hawakijuwile kija kiyakalile yokilonga Yesu.
Yesu komuhonya msuwameso
Yesu viyakalile behi na kuvika Yeliko, munhu imoja yakalile msuwameso kakala hamgwazo mnzila, kopula.
Munhu ayo viyahulike lunhu lwa wanhu lobita, kauza, “Kuna choni?”
Wanhu wamulongela, “Yesu wa Nazaleti kobita.”
Nayo kakemelela, “Yesu! Mwana wa Daudi! Nyonele bazi!”
Wanhu walongole wamkomhokela, wamulongela yanyamale. Lakini heyo kagendelela kukemelela ng'hani, “Mwana wa Daudi! Nyonele bazi!”
Avo Yesu kema, kalagiza munhu ija yagaligwe kumwake. Viyavikile behi, Yesu kamuuza,
“Kolonda nikutendele choni?” Nayo kamwidika, “Go mkulu, nolonda kulola.”
Yesu kamulongela, “Lola! Kutamanila kwako kukuhonya.”
Bahaja munhu ija kadaha kulola, kamkweleleza Yesu kuno komgwaa nhogolwa Imulungu. Wanhu wose viwone avo, wamgwaa nhogolwa Imulungu.
